SEO consulting

SEO consulting from the person doing the work

One-to-one advice about your rankings, your site and your Google profile, for owner-operated businesses in Denton and DFW.

What this is

Consulting is for the owner who does not want to hand this over. You want to understand what is going on, decide for yourself, and either do the work in-house or brief somebody properly.

What you get is straight answers from the person who does this work, rather than a proposal dressed as advice.

What you get

What people bring to this

  • 01

    Why am I not ranking

    The most common one. Usually answerable by looking, and usually the answer is one or two specific things rather than the long list people expect.

  • 02

    Is my agency doing anything

    Also common, and worth asking. You get an honest read on whether what you are paying for is real work, without me pitching to replace them.

  • 03

    Which of these should I do first

    You have a list of recommendations from somewhere and no way to judge what matters. Ordering it is often the most valuable half-hour available.

  • 04

    Is this worth doing at all

    Sometimes the honest answer for a particular business is that search is not where their customers are, and something else deserves the money. I would rather say that than take the work.

  • 05

    How do I brief someone

    What to ask for, what to insist on, and what to be suspicious of. Useful even when you are hiring someone else to do it.

What it costs

Quoted after a free consult, because what it takes depends entirely on what you already have. Book a call, I will tell you what is involved, and you get a number before anything starts. If you are already on a plan, this may fold into it: the tiers are on the pricing page.

Every conversation starts with a free consult. If a short call answers your question, that is the end of it and you owe nothing. Paid consulting is for when the question needs real work behind the answer, and you will know the cost before it starts.

How this differs

Search engine optimization is the work done for you. This is advice so you or your team can do it, or so you can judge whether somebody else is doing it properly.

Marketing strategy is the level above: whether search deserves your budget compared with everything else you could spend it on. This one assumes search is the subject and goes deeper.

If you want to learn the skill rather than get an answer to a specific problem, that is SEO training for business owners.

Questions

What people ask

What is the difference between this and the free consult?

The free consult is a conversation about your situation and an honest first read. Paid consulting is when answering properly means digging into your site, your profile and your competitors first. I will tell you which one your question needs rather than starting the meter automatically.

Do I have to hire you for the work afterwards?

No, and the advice is not written to make that the only option. If the answer is that your existing developer can handle it, that is what I will say.

Can you look at work someone else has done?

Yes, and it is a frequent request. You get an honest assessment. If the work is good I will say so.

Do you work with businesses outside DFW?

The work is not geographically limited in the way the building is, though local knowledge genuinely helps for local search. Ask on the call.

Bring me a question

Book a free consult. Tell me what you are trying to work out and I will tell you what I would do and why.
